title: Phil-IRI Cognitive Dimensions & School Admin Assessments (v0.4.31)
message: Authentic DepEd Phil-IRI cognitive dimensions (Literal, Inferential, Critical), School Admin standardized assessment monitoring, and automatic homeroom class enrollment.
changelog:
📊 WHAT'S NEW IN v0.4.31 (PHIL-IRI COGNITIVE DIMENSIONS & SCHOOL ADMIN ASSESSMENTS):
• Authentic Phil-IRI Cognitive Dimensions: Comprehensive reading metrics standardized to Literal, Inferential, and Critical Evaluation (DepEd Order No. 14, s. 2018) with a 3-point radar benchmarked against the 75% standard.
• School Admin Standardized Test Governance: School administrators can now monitor division-deployed Phil-IRI reading tests with strict campus-level data isolation and customized school MPS analytics.
• Automatic Homeroom Class Auto-Enrollment: Learners claiming accounts or signing in are immediately enrolled into their adviser's class section and homeroom subject list.
• Enhanced AI Content Moderation: Tightened document validation to reject unsafe, illegal, or fraudulent submissions.
• Firestore Security Fortification: Dedicated role-governed security rules for division timed assessments and student submissions.
